pages.text: Tobacconist includes a small advancement tree as optional milestones. Advancements do not unlock mechanics and are not required for progression; they simply mark important steps through the craft.

pages.title: Core Progression
pages.text: $(thing)A New Leaf$() — obtain any tobacco seed.$(br)$(thing)Homegrown$() — obtain a fresh tobacco leaf.$(br)$(thing)Cured to Perfection$() — obtain a cured leaf.$(br)$(thing)A Cut Above$() — obtain loose cut tobacco.

pages.title: Specialties
pages.text: $(thing)Tobacconist’s Eye$() — obtain the Spectacles.$(br)$(thing)Roll Your Own$() — make a cigarette.$(br)$(thing)Fine Taste$() — make a cigar.$(br)$(thing)Cloud Culture$() — prepare shisha tobacco.

pages.title: Master Tobacconist
pages.text: The final goal remembers your progress over time. Obtain Tobacconist’s Spectacles, a wooden smoking pipe, a cigarette, a cigar, shisha tobacco, and a Tobacco Barrel. You do $(bold)not$() need to carry all six at once.
